faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faq.quick_link: Something not working? Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) ↓
faq.q1: Nothing changes after following the steps?
faq.a1: If nothing changes after all steps, your ISP is blocking it! Unfortunately, ISP-level blocks cannot be bypassed.
faq.q2: Do I need to restart my PC?
faq.a2: After all steps, I strongly recommend restarting your PC! This is needed for network settings to apply properly.
faq.q3: Why aren't AI tools (ChatGPT) or TikTok working?
faq.a3: If you are connected to Russian servers, AI tools will not work! As well as TikTok and certain foreign services. You can check which country and server you are connected to on <1>2ip.io.
faq.q4: Can I change the server Cloudflare One Client connects to?
faq.a4: You CANNOT change the server Cloudflare One Client connects to! If connected to a Russian server — either use Russian servers (most blocked sites will work), or switch to another app.
faq.q5: Which zapret version should I download and where are the video files?
faq.a5: Download the latest version of zapret. It contains all the files from the video!

yandex_music.title: Yandex Music
yandex_music.subtitle: Playlist automation via browser developer console

unlike.title: Remove all tracks from "Liked Songs"
unlike.desc: Yandex Music does not have a bulk clear button for liked tracks. This script automatically goes through all tracks and unlikes them.
unlike.step1: Open the web version of <1>Yandex Music and go to Collection → Liked.
unlike.step2: Open developer tools: press F12 (or Ctrl + Shift + I) and select the Console tab.
unlike.step3: If your browser blocks pasting, type <1>allow pasting into the console and hit Enter.
unlike.step4: Copy the script below, paste it into the console, and press Enter. The script will safely remove tracks with an interval.

like.title: Bulk add tracks to "Liked Songs"
like.desc: Useful when importing music from Spotify, Apple Music, or saving an entire album / public playlist to your personal collection.
like.step1: Open the web version of <1>Yandex Music and open the playlist or album you want to like.
like.step2: Open developer tools: press F12 (or Ctrl + Shift + I) and select the Console tab.
like.step3: If your browser blocks pasting, type <1>allow pasting into the console and hit Enter.
like.step4: Copy the script below, paste it into the console, and press Enter. The script will automatically like every track.

yandex_music.tip_speed: Fast & reliable: the script uses optimized delays (120ms between clicks and 600ms for fetching) so actions register properly without rate limits.
yandex_music.tip_scroll: Auto scroll-container detection: the script automatically finds Yandex Music's scroll element and progressively renders virtualized track rows.
yandex_music.tip_stop: How to stop: the script will automatically finish once all tracks are processed. To abort at any moment, simply refresh the page (F5).
